bio.text: Scott Richardson is a Republican member of the Arkansas House of Representatives for District 13, which covers part of Benton County.
The legislature's member page lists Richardson's first House term as 2023 and shows Richardson as a veteran.
According to the House of Representatives biography, Richardson is a military veteran and Director of Information Systems at CEI Engineering and Associates, Inc., and lives in Bentonville.
The biography says Richardson graduated from Atkins High School and earned bachelor of science and master of science degrees from Arkansas Tech University.
